items.title: Representability of partial sums in generic absolute and positive web models
items.author: Christine Tasson; Aymeric Walch
items.source_version: Official published FSCD2026.29 CC BY4.0 PDF pp.29:1--23, retrieved2026-10-14; selected target Theorem59 pp.29:16--17 with published AppendixA support and definitions
items.difficulty_reason: The authors construct the summation object D=(N,l-infinity(N)) for generic absolute web models, encode every multi-indexed morphism family as a matrix h, identify its tensor powers by predual double orthogonality, and prove summability iff that matrix is a web morphism using the covering principle and predual summability characterization. The direct predual and covering proofs are retained; this is a non-routine categorical/matrix representation construction supporting H2, not a separately counted immediate Taylor corollary.

proof_spans.label: Complete official AppendixA covering/predual/matrix proofs needed by Theorem59
